segments.text: Good morning, my name is Niko Avelo and welcome back to Acme Tips.
Today we're joined by Ethan Houston with Finco.
Pleasure to meet you.
Pleasure to meet you Ethan, thank you for joining us.
Yes sir.
Can you tell us a little bit about Finco Ethan?
Finco is one of the leading manufacturers in ambient vaporizers.
We offer about 20 different models,
have a very skilled engineering department,
who can customize any unit to fit your needs.
Sounds like a great product and a great company.
Yes sir.
Now tell me, where would I find these?
What are they different applications?
You would see these from hospitals to filling soap pots, anything like that.
We have nitrogen service, also oxygen service.
Sounds like a great product.
If I wanted to buy this amazing product,
where can I buy it?
Reach out the echo gas.
Turn it here folks.
Thank you Ethan.
Yes sir.
